reply.text:
Tight back is a symptom, and that one is for a doctor or physio, not a coach. I won't tell you whether it's a problem or how to work around it. If it's been tight all week, getting it looked at is the right call before loading anything heavy.

On the training side, I can help you change the session itself. Tell me which day has the deadlifts and I can make the swap in your program, for example taking the heavy pulls out of that session. Do you want me to do that, and if so, which day should I target?
